git commit -F - <<'EOF'
feat(hook): refuse a repo-wide git worktree prune on every session (D-8001)

Cleanup un-wedge Task R3, step 2. A repository-wide `git worktree prune`
deletes git's record of every gone worktree at once, and ccd's cleanup
reads those records, so one session's prune holds the cleanup of every
lane on the box. `APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN_JQ` gains a `prune` row in `fmatch`
(GITPRE, GOPT, GITWT, GDRY; `norm` now defined before `fmatch`), read in
all three modes; both prefilters gain `*prune*`; the reason names the
scoped `git -C <main> worktree remove <path>` and allows a dry run.

An accident guard, not a wall: an assembled string, a script file, an
alias, `eval`, a `$VAR` program and `git gc` run past it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
